title: DFT optimization of Ima2 TaReSi
action: Perform DFT structural optimization of the Ima2 unit cell using PAW/GGA-PBE. Relax lattice parameters and atomic positions until convergence. Produce a relaxed structure file as evidence.
description: Relax the initial Ima2 crystal structure to obtain the equilibrium geometry for subsequent phonon and energy analyses.

title: Phonon dispersion and soft-mode identification for Ima2
action: Build a supercell from the relaxed Ima2 structure, compute forces for displaced atoms, and calculate the phonon dispersion using the direct method. Identify soft modes (imaginary frequencies) and report the instability summary focusing on the Γ and S points.
description: Phonon calculation to detect dynamical instability of the Ima2 structure. Reports presence of imaginary modes at Γ and S.
output_schema: object with keys: has_imaginary_modes (boolean), imaginary_frequencies_at_qpoints (array of objects with qpoint [3 floats] and frequencies [array of floats]), minimum_frequency_cm (float).

title: Energy-vs-amplitude scan for soft modes
action: For each soft-mode eigenvector at Γ and S, generate a series of structures by displacing atoms with varying amplitudes. Compute total energy per formula unit for each amplitude to map the energy curve. Store the scan data.
description: Maps total energy as a function of displacement amplitude along the unstable soft-mode eigenvectors to identify energy-minimizing distortions.

title: Extract energy-minimizing atomic displacements
action: From the energy-vs-amplitude curves, determine the atomic displacement magnitudes (in Å) for each element at the energy minima for the Γ-mode and S-mode distortions. Report these shifts from the original Ima2 positions.
description: Atomic displacement magnitudes at energy minima for both soft-mode distortions, in angstroms.
output_schema: object with keys: gamma_mode (object with Ta, Re, Si displacement in Å), S_mode (object with Ta, Re, Si displacement in Å).

title: Relax S-mode-displaced structure and identify symmetry
action: Fully relax the structure obtained by applying the S-mode energy-minimizing displacement. Optimize lattice parameters and atomic positions. Perform symmetry analysis to determine the space group. Output the final CIF file.
description: Relaxed crystal structure from the S-point soft-mode distortion, expected to exhibit Cm (space group No. 8) symmetry.
output_schema: Standard CIF file containing the relaxed structure.

title: Phonon calculation for S-mode-derived Cm structure
action: Compute the phonon dispersion for the relaxed Cm structure using the direct method. Save the dispersion data for verification.
description: Phonon dispersion computation to verify dynamical stability of the Cm phase.

title: Phonon stability report for Cm
action: Analyze the phonon dispersion of the Cm structure and report whether any imaginary modes are present. Confirm dynamical stability.
description: Stability check of the Cm structure: all phonon frequencies must be non-negative (no imaginary modes).
output_schema: object with keys: all_frequencies_positive (boolean), minimum_phonon_frequency_cm (float), no_imaginary_modes_confirmed (boolean).
